title: Refactor for performance with exact output equivalence (log report)
prompt: This repo builds a usage report from access logs (package `logstats/`). Read PERF.md: `build_report` is far too slow and must handle 200,000 lines in well under 3 seconds, while its output stays exactly identical to the current implementation for every input, including edge cases and quirks. Refactor the code across `logstats/` to fix this. Run the tests with `python -m pytest -q`; they are not a complete check of equivalence. When you are done, stop.
